description:
Manage static ISP IPs (wraps /v1/static_house/* developer-api endpoints).

**Actions:** "open" = purchase new IPs (WRITE, gated by approval_token; local MCP server only — not available on the hosted endpoint). "renew" = renew existing IPs (WRITE, gated by approval_token; local MCP server only — not available on the hosted endpoint). "export"/"list" = read-only, dial credentials masked; available on every runtime. "reveal_credentials" = shows the REAL proxy username/password for the filtered IPs — local MCP server only (not available on the hosted endpoint); only use when the human user explicitly asked for them (e.g. to configure another tool with their own static IPs). With an elicitation-capable MCP client, "reveal_credentials" is a single call confirmed by the human user in a live dialog; otherwise it uses the same preview + approval_token two-step as "open"/"renew".
**Behavior for "open"/"renew"/"reveal_credentials":** call once WITHOUT `approval_token` to get a preview plus a fresh token (valid 10 minutes) — for "open"/"renew" this does NOT hit the API; for "reveal_credentials" it shows only masked IP/port/region/expiry (no credentials yet), or is skipped entirely when the connected client confirms via an elicitation dialog instead. Re-call with the EXACT SAME parameters plus that token to execute. `confirm: true` is a deprecated no-op.
**Auth:** NOVADA_DEVELOPER_API_KEY (falls back to NOVADA_API_KEY).

action.description: Action to perform. "open" = purchase new static IPs (WRITE, requires approval_token; local MCP server only). "renew" = renew existing IPs (WRITE, requires approval_token; local MCP server only). "export" = export filtered IP list (masked credentials). "list" = list static IPs with pagination (masked credentials). "reveal_credentials" = show REAL dial username/password for filtered IPs — local MCP server only (not available on the hosted endpoint); with an elicitation-capable MCP client this is a single call confirmed by the human user in a dialog, otherwise a preview + approval_token two-step. Only use when the human explicitly asked for them.

approval_token.description: Two-step approval token, required to execute "open"/"renew"/"reveal_credentials". Omit on the first call to receive a preview + a fresh approval_token (valid 10 minutes). Re-call with the EXACT SAME parameters plus this field set to that token to execute. Never invent a value — an invented or stale token is rejected.

confirm.description: DEPRECATED — ignored. Setting this alone no longer authorizes "open"/"renew"/"reveal_credentials" execution (closed 2026-09, finding F2-2: an agent could self-supply confirm:true with no prior human-reviewed preview, including a PURCHASE — see F2-eval R9). Use approval_token instead: call once WITHOUT approval_token to receive a preview and a token, then call again with the identical parameters plus approval_token.

duration.description: Required for "open" and "renew". Activation/renewal period: "week" or "month".

key_word.description: Search filter for "list"/"export". Searches remarks, order number, or IP.

limit.description: Entries per page for "list" action. Default 50, max 200.

num.description: Required for "open". Number of static IPs to activate.

region.description: Required for "open". Area/region code. Also optional filter for "list" and "export".

renew_ip_list.description: Required for "renew". Comma-separated list of IPs to renew.

status.description: Filter for "list"/"export". Omit to default to "1" (in-use only) — expired/released IPs are counted in a summary line but not returned. Pass "" explicitly for All, "1" for In use, "2" for Expired, or "3" for Released to override the default.
